preconditions.description: The number of vectors in S is at least 1 and at most 5 * 10^5.
The number of dimensions is at least 1 and at most 5 * 10^5.
Each vector in S has at most 2 coordinates equal to 1.
The coordinates of each vector are between 1 and m.

preconditions.expression: No two vectors in S are the same
preconditions.description: All vectors in S are unique.

postconditions.description: The output consists of two integers: the size of T modulo 10^9+7 and the size of S'.
The second line of output contains the indices of the elements of S' in ascending order.

postconditions.expression: all(v in T for v in S'[i:] for i in range(len(S')))
postconditions.description: All vectors in T can be written as a sum of vectors from S'.
The size of S' is the smallest possible to generate all vectors in T.
In case there are multiple such sets with a minimal number of elements, the output set S' is the lexicographically smallest one.

invariants.expression: T is the set of all vectors that can be written as a sum of some vectors from S
invariants.description: T is defined as the set of all possible sums of vectors from S.
The size of T is calculated and given modulo 10^9+7.

invariants.expression: S' is the smallest subset of S that can generate all vectors in T
invariants.description: S' is the smallest subset of S such that all vectors in T can be generated by summing vectors from S'.
